notes: ResDepth (Stucker & Schindler 2022) with the lasground_new DTM as the initial raster (channel 0) and LiDAR rasters as guidance: per-tile mean centring + global std, L1 in metres, Adam 2e-4 with weight decay 1e-5, batch 20, StepLR, augmentation by 90-degree rotations and flips only (as in ResDepth). ResDepth trains 20000 samples per epoch with the LR divided by 10 every 200 epochs; here step_size is in iterations (200 epochs x 1000 iterations). Runs in fp32 (no autocast) so heights are not rounded to bf16.
